name: Ha Long resort living
summary: The stay is a night on the bay after the day boats, or a room in Bãi Cháy before an early pier. The published overnight line does not name a boat.
body: You sleep aboard, or you sleep in phường Bãi Cháy and board in the morning. The 15 March 2024 tourism page prints an overnight average of 600,000–800,000 đồng a person. It does not say what that ticket includes.
Tuần Châu is the other port in the same notice. A room in phường Bãi Cháy is the early start, before you board.
